Product: 러스트 캔버스 툴 롤
Design invariants: Fictional concept sample. Small rectangular rust canvas tool roll with exactly three adjacent equal open-top inner pockets across its lower half, one single cotton tie attached at side edge, plain rectangular outer back, no flap zipper snaps handles extra pockets or labels. Preserve all geometry and hardware counts. No logos or readable lettering.
Color: rust orange brown. Material: cotton canvas.
Required view: Macro rust canvas weave and one pocket seam.
Extreme macro crop: only the requested surface detail fills the frame; not the whole object.
Soft diffused daylight, warm pale gray studio unless required view specifies setting. No collage, text, logos, watermark or duplicated products. Preserve construction, color, material and hardware counts exactly.
Ordered references: Image 1: authoritative front view, preserve same product construction and any usage objects/person where relevant. Change only requested view/scene; use all references.
